# Universal Multi-Agent Specification: Save My Disk (save-my-disk) 🚀 (v0.5.3)

This specification defines how **ANY AI Agent framework** (WorkBuddy, Cursor, Windsurf, AutoGen, CrewAI, LangChain, OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, DeepSeek Harness, etc.) should discover, expose, and safely execute this toolset.

---

## 🚨 Explicit Invocation Policy (必须显式调用)

> **CRITICAL SECURITY GUARDRAIL FOR ALL AGENTS**:
> 磁盘运维属于系统高危敏感操作。
> 1. **严禁隐式触发**：在用户进行普通写代码、日常问答时，AI 严禁擅自启动本技能或自作主张执行磁盘清理。
> 2. **必须显式唤起**：只有当用户在提示词中明确提到 `save-my-disk`，或直接要求对磁盘进行体检与清理时，方可激活本规范。
> 3. **清单呈批与双轨直呈**：任何删除命令前，必须先生成结构化 4-Tier 候选清单（带 `SYS-xxx`, `RES-xxx`, `DEV-xxx`, `PKG-xxx`, `AI-xxx`, `IM-xxx`, `BRW-xxx` 独立编号），**既要在聊天窗口完整直呈表格，也要提供本地清单文件链接**，获得用户明确授权确认后方可执行。

---

## Agent Detection & Activation Triggers
Only activate this runbook when user prompt explicitly matches:
* "save-my-disk", "调用 save-my-disk", "运行 save-my-disk 技能"
* "系统盘清理体检", "检查磁盘空间残留" (Explicit storage intent)

## Standard Multi-Agent Protocol & Dual-Channel Rule

1. **Step 1: Discover & Audit (只读体检)**
   Run `audit_drives.ps1 -Json`, `scan_app_residues.ps1 -OutputManifest ./.save-my-disk/cleanup_manifest.md -Json`, `scan_browser_system_caches.ps1 -OutputManifest ./.save-my-disk/cleanup_manifest.md -Json`, `scan_package_caches.ps1 -OutputManifest ./.save-my-disk/cleanup_manifest.md -Json`, `scan_ai_models.ps1 -OutputManifest ./.save-my-disk/cleanup_manifest.md -Json`, `scan_im_office_residues.ps1 -OutputManifest ./.save-my-disk/cleanup_manifest.md -Json`, and `scan_dev_artifacts.ps1 -DaysInactive 60 -OutputManifest ./.save-my-disk/cleanup_manifest.md -Json`.

2. **Step 2: Dual-Channel Presentation (双轨直呈呈批 - 必须执行)**
   * **通道一 (对话框直呈)**：Agent 必须在聊天框中输出清晰的 4-Tier 分类 Markdown 表格：
     * 🟢 **Tier 1 (零风险系统与日志项)**：包含 Windows 升级备份状态（若为 0 MB 明确提示“已由系统自动清理/健康”）、Windows Update 补丁缓存、Temp 文件、pip/npm/Gradle 临时下载缓存、浏览器临时编译与着色器缓存（Chrome/Edge/Brave Code Cache、GPUCache、Firefox cache2）、DirectX/NVIDIA/AMD 渲染着色器缓存 (`BRW-xxx`)、飞书/钉钉排错日志。
     * 🟡 **Tier 2 (开发者权衡、AI大模型与沉睡文档)**：NVIDIA 驱动离线安装包、沉睡工程构建产物 (`DEV-xxx`)、WSL2/Docker 虚拟磁盘、Hugging Face/Ollama/PyTorch 模型快照 (`AI-xxx`)、微信 3.x/4.0 历史接收文档与聊天图片 (`IM-xxx`)。
     * 🟠 **Tier 3 (应用残留与流媒体缓存)**：Steam 卸载空壳、微信 3.x/4.0/企微/QQ 视频播放缓存与表情缩略图 (`IM-xxx`)、办公/通讯软件诊断日志 (`RES-xxx`)。
     * 🔴 **Tier 4 (保护红线)**：声明系统核心、Conda 激活环境 (`envs/`)、**浏览器账号密码与身份凭据 (`Login Data`, `Cookies`, `History`, `Bookmarks`, `places.sqlite`, `key4.db`)**、**所有微信/QQ聊天记录核心数据库 (`*.db`, `*.kvdb`, `db_storage`, `Msg`)** 与正在工作的项目源码绝对安全免疫。
   * **通道二 (可点击清单路径)**：明确给出本地清单文件路径链接：`[.save-my-disk/cleanup_manifest.md](file:///绝对路径/.save-my-disk/cleanup_manifest.md)`。
   * **确认指引**：明确说明两种确认清理方式：
     * 方式 A：在对话框回复想要清理的编号（如：“清理 SYS-001 和 IM-001”）；
     * 方式 B：在本地 `cleanup_manifest.md` 文件中将 `[ ]` 改为 `[x]` 保存后回复：“已勾选，按清单清理”。

3. **Step 3: Guarded Execution (受控执行)**
   Only pass the user-confirmed IDs to `clean_selected_residues.ps1 -TargetIds ... -Force` or run with `-FromManifest -Force`.

4. **Step 4: Verify & Report (战果自愈与战报刷新)**
   Run `verify_health.ps1 -ExportHtml -Json` to confirm recovered space, ensure system services are healthy, and auto-refresh the visual dashboard (`.save-my-disk/disk_triage_report.html`).

# Save My Disk (save-my-disk) Skill 🚀 (v0.5.3)

> **安全准则**：本技能属于系统级敏感运维操作。**必须在用户显式呼叫时才启动**。任何阶段严禁暗中执行删除动作，所有清理步骤均须呈批候选清单并获得用户靶向授权。

## Core Rules for Any Agent

1. **Explicit Call Only (显式触发)**: Do not trigger or suggest disk cleanup unless the user explicitly mentions `save-my-disk` or specifically requests a storage audit.
2. **Read-Only First (只读体检)**: Never delete, move, or modify any file during the initial audit phase.
3. **Itemize Before Clean (清单呈批)**: Present an itemized list with unique IDs (`SYS-xxx`, `RES-xxx`, `DEV-xxx`, `PKG-xxx`, `AI-xxx`, `IM-xxx`, `BRW-xxx`) in `.save-my-disk/cleanup_manifest.md`.
4. **Preserve Source Code, Chat Databases & Browser Credentials (绝不误伤源码、聊天数据库与浏览器凭证)**: When cleaning inactive dev artifacts, IM caches, or browser/system caches, NEVER delete project root, source files, chat history databases (`*.db`, `*.kvdb`, `Msg`, `db_storage`), or browser credentials/user profiles (`Login Data`, `Cookies`, `History`, `Bookmarks`, `places.sqlite`, `key4.db`).
5. **Dual-Channel Reporting (双轨直呈与透明建档 - 必须严格执行)**:
   * **通道一 (对话框直报)**：体检完成后，Agent **必须**在对话框气泡中直接打印完整的 **4 级风险梯度 (4-Tier) Markdown 表格**，包括已清理项的状态（如 `$WINDOWS.~BT` 汇报 0 MB 健康状态，解答用户关于 cleanmgr 的疑问），让用户无需打开文件即可一览无余。
   * **通道二 (可点击清单)**：Agent **必须**在回复中提供本地清单文件的绝对路径可点击链接（`[.save-my-disk/cleanup_manifest.md](file:///绝对路径/.save-my-disk/cleanup_manifest.md)`），明确告知用户该文件是人机同步的单一真实事实来源（SSOT）。
   * **双轨决策确认指引**：明确向用户说明两种确认方式：
     * **方式 A (对话框直接回复)**：在聊天框回复编号（如“清理 SYS-001 和 IM-001”）；
     * **方式 B (清单文件打勾确认)**：直接打开 `cleanup_manifest.md` 将目标项改为 `[x]` 保存后回复“已勾选，按清单清理”。
6. **Explicit Confirmation (靶向授权)**: Only execute deletion for targets explicitly confirmed by the user.
7. **Post-Cleanup Verification (战果自愈)**: Always verify volume capacity and critical service health after any deletion using [scripts/verify_health.ps1](./scripts/verify_health.ps1).

---

## Standard Workflow

### Phase 1: Non-Invasive 4-Tier Audit (只读体检与建档)
1. Volume & Hotspot Scan:
   ```powershell
   powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/audit_drives.ps1 -Json
   ```
2. Application Residues & Safe Caches Scan (Generates 4-Tier Manifest base):
   ```powershell
   powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/scan_app_residues.ps1 -OutputManifest ./.save-my-disk/cleanup_manifest.md -Json
   ```
3. Browser & GPU Shader Caches Scan (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Firefox, DirectX/NVIDIA Shader Caches):
   ```powershell
   powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/scan_browser_system_caches.ps1 -OutputManifest ./.save-my-disk/cleanup_manifest.md -Json
   ```
4. Global Package Manager Caches Scan (pip, npm, Conda, Gradle):
   ```powershell
   powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/scan_package_caches.ps1 -OutputManifest ./.save-my-disk/cleanup_manifest.md -Json
   ```
5. AI/ML Model Storage Scan (Hugging Face, Ollama, PyTorch checkpoints):
   ```powershell
   powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/scan_ai_models.ps1 -OutputManifest ./.save-my-disk/cleanup_manifest.md -Json
   ```
6. Domestic IM & Office Caches Scan (WeChat 3.x/4.0, WXWork, QQ, Feishu, DingTalk):
   ```powershell
   powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/scan_im_office_residues.ps1 -OutputManifest ./.save-my-disk/cleanup_manifest.md -Json
   ```
7. Inactive Developer Build Artifacts Scan (> 60 days inactive, auto-inserts into Tier 2):
   ```powershell
   powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/scan_dev_artifacts.ps1 -DaysInactive 60 -OutputManifest ./.save-my-disk/cleanup_manifest.md -Json
   ```
8. WSL2 & Docker VHDX Analysis:
   ```powershell
   powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/manage_wsl_disk.ps1 -Json
   ```

### Phase 2: Dual-Channel Reporting & User Decision (双轨汇报与呈批)
Agent 必须在对话中向用户输出：
1. **直接在聊天框呈现 4-Tier 候选表格**（Tier 1 零风险系统项与包缓存、Tier 2 开发者权衡项与AI大模型、Tier 3 软件残留、Tier 4 保护红线）。
2. **给出本地清单文件的可点击链接**：`[.save-my-disk/cleanup_manifest.md](file:///绝对路径/.save-my-disk/cleanup_manifest.md)`。
3. **可选择提供单文件 HTML 可视化战报链接**（经由 `export_dashboard.ps1` 生成的 `[.save-my-disk/disk_triage_report.html](file:///绝对路径/.save-my-disk/disk_triage_report.html)`）。
4. **提示用户两种确认清理的方式**（对话框回复编号 / 清单打勾保存）。

### Phase 3: Controlled Execution (受控靶向执行)
1. **Targeted Residues / Dev Artifacts / Package Caches / AI Models / System Caches**:
   ```powershell
   # Via checked boxes in manifest
   powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/clean_selected_residues.ps1 -FromManifest -Force
   # Or via explicit IDs
   powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/clean_selected_residues.ps1 -TargetIds SYS-001,RES-001,PKG-001,DEV-001 -Force
   ```
2. **WSL2 / Docker VHDX Compaction (Requires Admin & User Consent)**:
   ```powershell
   powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/manage_wsl_disk.ps1 -Compact -Force
   ```
3. **Windows Update Cache (Requires Admin & User Consent)**:
   ```powershell
   powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/clean_windows_update.ps1
   ```

### Phase 4: Post-Cleanup Verification & Visual Dashboard (战果自愈与战报刷新)
```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/verify_health.ps1 -ExportHtml
```

## 🌟 核心理念 (Core Philosophy)

1. **只读优先 (Read-Only First)**：初筛体检阶段严禁执行任何写操作，严格规避死循环与高 I/O 锁盘，前台进程丝滑不卡顿。
2. **四级风险决策矩阵 (Risk-Tiered Triage)**：
   * 🟢 **Tier 1 (无痛零风险)**：系统更新补丁、`$WINDOWS.~BT`、临时文件、传递优化。
   * 🟡 **Tier 2 (开发者缓存 / 可迁移项)**：Docker 虚拟磁盘、Conda/pip/npm 缓存、AI 模型临时运行库。
   * 🟠 **Tier 3 (应用内治理与残留)**：Steam 卸载空残留、办公/聊天日志转储、微信与飞书媒体数据。
   * 🔴 **Tier 4 (绝对红线禁区)**：`System32`、`WinSxS`、正在工作的项目源码。
3. **双轨闭环执行 (Dual-Track Engine)**：
   * **Agent 自动化执行**：对零风险补丁缓存，由 Agent 提供一键脚本（**必须先获用户明确授权**）。
   * **Agent 人机协作引导**：对需要 GUI 权限的操作（如 `cleanmgr` 清理系统文件、Docker 虚拟盘无损迁移到大容量盘），Agent 输出极简分步指引。
4. **自愈与战果核验 (Verification)**：任何清理操作完成后，自动回访核对磁盘剩余空间差值，并验证关键系统服务健康状态。

# Contributing to Save My Disk (save-my-disk)

Thank you for your interest in contributing to `save-my-disk`! This project provides universal, non-invasive storage audit and safe cleanup runbooks for AI Coding Agents and developers.

## Core Contributing Principles

1. **Zero-Invasive Guarantee**: Scan and audit operations MUST remain strictly read-only and never delete or lock user files during discovery.
2. **Targeted Confirmation (SSOT)**: All deletions must be explicitly gated through the structured manifest file (`.save-my-disk/cleanup_manifest.md`) or explicit candidate IDs (`SYS-xxx`, `RES-xxx`, `DEV-xxx`).
3. **Protected Red Line (Tier 4)**: Scripts must strictly refuse to delete operating system core files (`System32`, `WinSxS`), active user project source code, and personal chat history databases.
4. **Mock Sandbox Testing**: Any new scanner or cleaner script must be paired with automated unit tests in `tests/test_mock_sandbox.ps1` running against an isolated temporary directory in `$env:TEMP`.
5. **Character Encoding**: PowerShell `.ps1` files must be saved with UTF-8 with BOM (`\xef\xbb\xbf`) to ensure compatibility with Windows PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7+.

## How to Submit Changes

1. Fork the repository and create your feature branch from `main`.
2. Implement your changes following the 4-Tier safety framework.
3. Run the automated test suite locally:
   ```powershell
   powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\tests\test_mock_sandbox.ps1
   ```
4. Commit your changes following Conventional Commits format (`feat: ...`, `fix: ...`, `docs: ...`).
5. Open a Pull Request against `main`. All CI checks must pass before merging.

# Windows Native Cleanmgr System Files Guide (系统文件清理标准指南)

This guide documents the gold-standard GUI cleanup workflow using Windows native `cleanmgr` with elevated system file cleanup privileges.

---

## Standard Procedure (标准执行流程)

### Step 1: Launch Cleanmgr in System Mode
1. Press `Win + R` to open the Windows Run dialog.
2. Type `cleanmgr` and press Enter.
3. Select drive `C:` and click **OK**.
4. In the dialog, click the button **"Clean up system files" (清理系统文件)** located at the bottom-left.
5. Windows will re-scan with full Administrator rights.

### Step 2: Select Items
Check all recommended safe checkboxes:
* **Previous Windows installation(s) / 以前的 Windows 安装**: Can easily free 20 GB ~ 50 GB (`$WINDOWS.~BT` / `Windows.old`).
* **Delivery Optimization Files / 传递优化文件**: Safe (frees ~1 GB).
* **Temporary Windows installation files / 临时 Windows 安装文件**: Safe (frees ~20 GB+).
* **Recycle Bin / 回收站**: Ensure no desired deleted files remain.
* **DirectX Shader Cache / 着色器缓存**: Safe.
* **Temporary files / 临时文件**: Safe.
* **Thumbnails / 缩略图**: Safe.

### Step 3: Execute
1. Click **OK**.
2. Click **Delete Files** on confirmation.
3. Allow the progress bar to finish (may take 2-5 minutes on large system installation rollbacks).

---

## When the Agent Should Recommend This
* Whenever `$WINDOWS.~BT` or `Windows.old` exceeds 10 GB.
* When the user prefers a native Windows UI without running CLI scripts.

# Developer Caches & Runtime Migration Guide (开发者缓存与环境治理指南)

---

## 1. Docker Desktop WSL2 Virtual Disk Migration (无损迁移到 D 盘)

### Why Migrate?
By default, Docker Desktop places `docker_data.vhdx` inside `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Docker\wsl\disk\`. As developers pull images, this file quickly consumes 20 GB ~ 50 GB of C: drive space, and WSL2 does not auto-shrink.

### GUI Migration Method (Docker Desktop 4.15+)
1. Open **Docker Desktop Settings** (Gear icon in top bar).
2. Navigate to **Resources** -> **Advanced** (or **Virtual disk limit / Disk image location** depending on version).
3. Under **Disk image location**, click **Browse** and select a folder on a secondary drive (e.g. `D:\Docker\`).
4. Click **Apply & restart**. Docker will automatically move the 20 GB `.vhdx` file to D:.

### CLI Compacting (If not migrating)
```powershell
# In PowerShell:
wsl --shutdown
diskpart
# In diskpart prompt:
# select vdisk file="C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Local\Docker\wsl\disk\docker_data.vhdx"
# compact vdisk
# exit
```

---

## 2. Conda & Package Managers

### Conda Tarballs
```bash
conda clean --packages --tarballs -y
```

### NPM Cache
```bash
npm cache clean --force
```

### Pip Cache
```bash
pip cache purge
```

---

## 3. Communication Apps (WeChat / Lark)

* **Feishu / Lark**:
  1. Open Feishu -> Click Avatar (Top Left) -> **Settings**.
  2. Navigate to **General** -> **Storage Management**.
  3. Click **Clear Cache** (removes temporary media, retains message text).

* **WeChat**:
  1. Open WeChat -> Click Menu (Bottom Left) -> **Settings**.
  2. Navigate to **General** -> **Storage Space**.
  3. Click **Manage** to selectively delete older video/file downloads.

# Disk Triage Safety Matrix (风险分级决策矩阵)

This matrix defines the directory classification, safety levels, and handling policies for AI Agents.

---

## 🟢 Tier 1: Zero-Risk / Pure Cache (无痛零风险 - 可在用户确认后自动化执行)

| Target Path | Description | Recommended Agent Action |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `C:\$WINDOWS.~BT` | Windows version upgrade residual & rollback archive | Instruct user to run `cleanmgr` (Clean up system files) or execute automated removal |
| `C:\Windows\SoftwareDistribution\Download` | Windows Update downloaded patch packages | Stop `wuauserv` -> purge directory -> restart `wuauserv` |
| `C:\Windows\SoftwareDistribution\Download.bak` | Historical dead backup folder | Delete immediately |
| `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp` | User temporary files from installers/unzippers | Clear non-locked files |
| `C:\$RECYCLE.BIN` | Recycle Bin | Confirm with user, then empty |
| `Delivery Optimization Files` | P2P patch sharing cache | Purge via cleanmgr or PowerShell |
| Game uninstaller residue | Empty folders after game uninstall | Safe to delete |

---

## 🟡 Tier 2: Developer Caches & Runtimes (开发者缓存 - 建议迁移或定向修剪)

| Target Path | Description | Recommended Agent Action |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Docker\wsl\disk\docker_data.vhdx` | Docker Desktop WSL2 virtual disk | **Do not directly delete!** Guide user to migrate disk to secondary drive (e.g. D:) or run `docker system prune` |
| `%USERPROFILE%\miniconda3\pkgs` | Conda downloaded package tarballs | Run `conda clean --packages --tarballs` |
| `%USERPROFILE%\.cache\codex-runtimes` | Code generation sandbox runtime installs | Keep primary active runtime; purge temporary `*-install-*` directories |
| `%LOCALAPPDATA%\npm-cache` | Node.js npm package cache | Run `npm cache clean --force` |
| `%USERPROFILE%\.gradle\caches` | Gradle build tool dependencies | Safe to delete if willing to re-download on next build |
| `C:\hiberfil.sys` | Windows hibernation memory snapshot | If user does not use hibernation, guide `powercfg -h off` |

---

## 🟠 Tier 3: Application Internal Storage (应用内数据 - 必须应用内治理)

| Target Path | Description | Recommended Agent Action |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `%APPDATA%\LarkShell` | Feishu / Lark chat media & docs cache | Guide user: Settings -> General -> Storage Management -> Clear Cache |
| `%USERPROFILE%\xwechat_files` | WeChat received media & cache | Guide user: Settings -> General -> Storage Management -> Manage |
| `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Packages` | Windows UWP app sandbox data | Guide user: Windows Settings -> Apps -> Installed Apps -> Reset |

---

## 🔴 Tier 4: Red Line / Forbidden (绝对禁区 - 严禁手动删除)

| Target Path | Description | Why It Must Not Be Touched |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `C:\Windows\System32` & `SysWOW64` | OS core binaries and libraries | Immediate BSOD / system death |
| `C:\Windows\WinSxS` | Windows Component Store | Breaks Windows servicing; only manageable via `DISM /online /cleanup-image` |
| `C:\pagefile.sys` & `swapfile.sys` | System virtual memory | Locked by kernel; can only be relocated via Advanced System Settings |
| `%USERPROFILE%\Desktop\*` (e.g. `HDU-World`) | User project files, source codes, coursework | High risk of permanent data loss |
| `C:\Program Files` & `(x86)` root | Active installed software binaries | Corrupts installed applications and registry entries |
